title: Among female patients diagnosed with SLE who have an abnormal Ig M level an
question: Among female patients diagnosed with SLE who have an abnormal Ig M level and whose laboratory test was conducted before the year 2010, find the one with the highest total cholesterol. Return her ID, sex, birthday, examination date (from Laboratory), and total cholesterol value.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_058", T1."XCL_059", T1."XCL_060", T2."XCL_015", T2."XCL_026"
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_014"
WHERE T1."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND T1."XCL_064" = 'SLE'
  AND T2."XCL_044" > 400
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2."XCL_015") < '2010'
ORDER BY T2."XCL_026" DESC
LIMIT 1
